confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the city context only; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Beer, coffee and restaurant anchors are the firmer part. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July demand, neighborhood location and the FIFA World Cup 2026 matches in the Los Angeles area can move rates widely. Cocktail and wine were set from the local price relationship to beer (cocktail about 2x beer, wine about 1.9x beer) because direct price knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from RBA exchange-rate pages surfaced by web search; the F11.1 data file itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Estimate built from general knowledge of Los Angeles price levels, loosely benchmarked against other large US West Coast visitor cities such as San Francisco and San Diego.
